svg.title: journey diagram
svg.desc: A user journey diagram with 7 nodes and 6 edges. Organized in 2 groups. Flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: Visit homepage, Search products, View product. Key relationships: Visit homepage connects to Search products; Search products connects to View product; View product connects to Add to cart. Layout spans 1761 by 294 units with 7 rendered node boxes and 6 routed edge paths.

g.title: Visit homepage connects to Search products
Search products connects to View product
View product connects to Add to cart
Add to cart connects to Checkout
